scope.rule: Intersection of photographic ground coverage, nadir ULS XY support, ALS XY support and raw LoD2 tile coverage. No MVS availability or patch outcome enters selection.
scope.coverage_origin: integer multiple of 0.5 m in EPSG:25832
scope.coverage_source: Raw full nadir extent; 0.5 m grid; ALS point occupancy; photographic coverage by projection into posed images of ALS class-2 ground height (nearest filled where empty).
scope.image_support: Camera frustum on ALS terrain: grid centre in front and inside native 1400 x 1013 undistorted image. No MVS-depth requirement. Existing MVS occupancy is inventory only.
scope.building_membership: GroundSurface XY intersects common support. Preserve whole building split; patch centre must be inside common XY support.

split.forced_development: any GroundSurface intersection with four evaluation ranges or seven exploration ranges
split.other_buildings: sort exact building IDs ascending, numpy default_rng(20261023).choice without replacement
split.patch_assignment: LoD2 owning face; ALS faces from view_v1_1.json faces exactly; no face match excluded
split.seal: all holdout patch outcomes and candidate places only in /out/holdout; no cell areas in reports or either archive

grid.ownership: Unregistered patch centre in core (lower inclusive, upper exclusive) and common support; registered coordinates used for measurements. Boundary ownership never moves with fitted shifts.

tau_source.ALS: median of B0 12.66, B173nb 14.70, R1 10.34 cm, user order 3.4
tau_source.LoD2: User clarification in this chat on 2026-10-24: use 20 cm; applies to roof-like and wall-like patches.
tau_source.role: Evaluation threshold only; same numeric value as existing LoD2 uncertainty is not a change of its definition

patch.source: stage-1 plane/TIN store constructors and outward normals from main_uncert_v1

definitions.s0_rule: s0 = 1.4826 × (1 + 5 ÷ (고리 점 수 − 3)) × √(제곱 잔차의 중앙값); 중앙값은 numpy median(짝수 개면 가운데 둘의 평균)
definitions.one_sided_rule: 고리 점이 c 둘레의 네 사분면 가운데 셋 미만에만 있음. 사분면 = n에 수직인 두 축(e1 = 연직 또는 x축과 n의 외적, e2 = n × e1)의 부호. 점이 하나라도 있으면 그 사분면에 있음
definitions.weak_support_rule: 잔차가 2.5 s0 안인 고리 점이 고리 점의 절반 미만. 잔차 = 고른 평면(최소 중앙 제곱)의 잔차(1.2-1의 문장 그대로). 이 정의는 만들어지는 꼴상 늘 절반 이상이다(제곱 잔차의 절반 이상이 중앙값 이하이고 2.5 s0 ≥ 3.7√중앙값). 그래서 다시 맞춘 최소 제곱 평면의 잔차로 같은 비율을 support_final로 함께 남긴다(표시에는 쓰지 않음, 표 1에 나란히 적음)
definitions.multi_layer_rule: 참값 면 찾기에서 20 % 이상인 층(5 cm씩 옮긴 층)이 끊기지 않고 이어진 묶음을 하나로 세어, 묶음이 둘 이상이면 '여러 층'
definitions.face_rule: 1.1: 옆 거리 0.5 m 안이고 법선 거리가 기둥 범위 안인 점을 모으고(M개), 위 끝 +H부터 5 cm씩 내리며 [위 − 0.3, 위] 층(양 끝 포함)의 점 수가 0.2 M 이상인 첫 층의 가운데가 o. 그런 층이 없거나 M = 0이면 '면 없음'
definitions.slab_rule: 셈에 쓰는 점 = 기둥 안에서 법선 거리 o − 1 m ~ o + 1 m (양 끝 포함). 안쪽 원 = 옆 거리 ≤ 0.5 m, 고리 = 0.5 m < 옆 거리 ≤ R
definitions.count_rule: 점 부족 = 솎기 전 안쪽 원 점 < 5 또는 고리 점 < 20. 참값 부족 = 참값 안쪽 원 점(o_G ± 1 m, 옆 거리 0.5 m 안) < 10
definitions.inner_set_rule: u, 어긋남, 흩어짐, q, 자료의 자리 p, 실제 오차는 모두 같은 안쪽 원 점(MVS는 솎은 2,000점, 그 밖은 모두)으로 구한다. MVS의 영상 수는 솎기 전 안쪽 원 점에서 센다
definitions.plane_rule: 고리 평면의 '법선과 c에서의 거리' = 다시 맞춘 평면의 법선 m(n 쪽)과 c에서 평면까지의 부호 거리((평면 위 점 − c)·m)
definitions.lmeds_speed_note: 가장 작은 중앙값을 찾는 셈은 u_core.lmeds_argmin(먼저 좋은 후보의 중앙값 m*을 구하고, 제곱 잔차의 절반 이상이 m* 이하인 후보만 정확한 중앙값을 셈)이다. np.argmin(np.median)과 답이 같음을 모의 점 300벌에서 확인했다(u_test.json).

ground_truth.rule: Stage-1 v3 ground-truth point preparation and exclusions, then main_uncert_v1 column/face/plane definitions
ground_truth.B0_difference: Previous uncertainty mixed nadir and manual ULS; retain old values as comparison only, never include manual points in this task
ground_truth.height_shift_source: Use exact stage-1 v3 frozen common_shift_m from v3/align/common_shift.json for nadir ULS; no new GT alignment fit.

mvs.evaluation_rule: 2026-09-15 candidate rule; name order index % 8 == 0 is evaluation on the full scoped candidate list
mvs.variant: a: geometric depth, finite > 0 and confidence > 0
mvs.wait_rule: Wait while any other compute process uses a GPU; record wait duration; GPU for MVS depth only

components.radius_fallback: if median nearest-neighbour spacing < 0.18 or > 0.36 m, use 1.5 * that median; record it
components.building_note: Connectivity follows same-cell distance only; components crossing buildings retain all building IDs and per-building areas. Development and holdout are always processed separately.

cells.mvs_error: actual error e from main_uncert_v1, not abs(mvs_p - gt_p)
cells.missing_reasons: Retain original face, point-count and plane-fit failure status; never convert missing values to zero
cells.availability: Prior comparison requires inherited GT status 0 and finite gt_p. Other GT states enter no_gt with the original reason, including no face, insufficient points and plane failure; they are never reported as all zero-point cases. MVS correctness uses finite actual error e even when the ring fit or uncertainty is unavailable. Nonfinite e enters the appropriate no_mvs cell; a finite e with missing mvs_p remains in its correctness cell but is absent from difference distributions, whose missing area is reported.

figures.holdout: grey hatching on scope map only; no holdout outcome plots or photo crops
figures.image_rule: largest projected component in a nadir training image; original resolution crop; GT-height outline
figures.photo_selection: descending component area; ties building ID then component ID; no cause labels
figures.photo_margin_detail: Project component patch corners moved by gt_p along normal; dilate their original-image outline by the projection of 3 m in the patch tangent plane for crop bounds. Retain image-edge clipping and missing-photo reasons.

execution.stage_dependency: Stage A input/scope/split and prior meshes on CPU. New-area registered-prior errors require training-only MVS absent outside historical boxes. State this in the intermediate report, then complete CPU prior-error measurements after authorized stage B MVS; no evaluated-image MVS substituted.

amendments.reason: MVS-derived coverage would remove MVS-absent places requested by the order. Replace it with geometric photograph coverage and invalidate the preliminary building split before any outcomes.

previous_scope.rule: Intersection of observed image-derived MVS XY support, nadir ULS XY support, ALS XY support and raw LoD2 tile coverage. No patch outcome enters selection.
previous_scope.coverage_origin: integer multiple of 0.5 m in EPSG:25832
previous_scope.coverage_source: Inherited survey 0.5 m occupancy rasters; verify nadir header and current image geometry remain inside raster bounds; extend from raw inputs if needed.
previous_scope.image_support: Existing 937-image MVS used for source coverage inventory only. It contains evaluation images and is not the new training-only MVS or error measurement.
previous_scope.building_membership: GroundSurface XY intersects common support. Preserve whole building split; patch centre must be inside common XY support.

amendments.reason: Preserve same-cell connectivity without adding a building/roof barrier; record random indices for new tiles and inherited GT shift. New-area prior registration needs training-only depth, so CPU error tables follow MVS rather than using evaluation-contaminated old depth.

Clarify exclusive cells when inherited GT or ring fit fails; retain finite actual errors independently of uncertainty availability. Make tile boundary ownership and photo margin explicit. No outcome inspected.

seed_rule: Inherited numpy default_rng scheme; full-area site index = sorted 100 m tile index. Prior index LoD2=0 ALS=1; data mvs_a=0 als=2 gt=3; ring=1 for 1.5 m and 9 for GT. Record changed context and indices in historical comparison.
